delivery.description: The delivery ULID. Matches X-Tmesis-Delivery. Duplicated in the body so a receiver that logs bodies has the dedupe key without the headers.

occurred_at.description: RFC3339 UTC, when the event happened on the node. ORDER BY THIS, never by arrival: delivery is unordered.

cause.description: expired: until passed. cleared: DELETE, or a desired-state revision without jobs_pause. released: the fleet pause ended with its enrollment (leave, or a boot under another enrollment).

source.description: Who set the pause that ended.

paused_at.description: When the ended pause started taking effect (its jobs.paused set_at).
